layout.arrangement: White slide enclosed in a thick dark-maroon border. Top-left: a bordered box headed 'Gradient Descent' in red italic with 3 equation lines: 2 weight-update equations and 1 'Where' delta equation. Top-right, largest element: a beige-panel feedforward neural-network diagram with 4 purple input dots, 3 hidden rows each containing a Σ circle, an f box, and 3 tiny output circles, a purple bias node '1' captioned 'Node Bias', 3 output rows each containing a Σ circle, an f box, and an O_j label labeled Output 1/2/m, magenta weight lines labeled w_ij/w_ji and Net_j, dashed backpropagation arrows, blue up-arrows, a red vertical 'Error Error Error' bar with 3 green Class boxes, and a yellow circle '9' at the far top-right corner. Middle band: 3 equations side by side, with error E on the left, sigmoid O_j in the center under a blue 'For Sigmoid Activation' kicker, and Net_j on the right; below them are 3 small boxed partial derivatives in a row. Bottom-left: 1 large bordered box containing the chain-rule expansion of ∂E/∂W_ji. Bottom-right: 1 pale-yellow box repeating the same 3 partial derivatives.

regions.name: gradient_descent_box
regions.content: Red italic header 'Gradient Descent'; equations W_ji^Updated = W_ji^old - η ∂E/∂W_ji; W_ji^Updated = W_ji^old + Δ_ji; red 'Where' + Δ_ji = -η ∂E/∂W_ji

regions.name: network_diagram
regions.content: Beige-panel 3-layer network: 4 purple input dots; 3 hidden rows each with a Σ circle, an f box, and 3 tiny output circles labeled O_i; a purple bias node '1' captioned 'Node Bias'; 3 output rows each with a Σ circle, an f box, and O_j, labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m; magenta lines labeled w_ij/w_ji and Net_j; dashed feedback arrows; blue up-arrows; a red vertical 'Error Error Error' bar with 3 green boxes reading Class 1, Class 2, Class m

regions.name: middle_equation_band
regions.position: middle, roughly y 40%-58%, full width x 3%-93%
regions.content: E = (1/2) Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2 on the left; blue italic 'For Sigmoid Activation' + O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^(-Net_j)) in the center; Net_j = Σ_i (w_ji O_i) on the right; below them, 3 boxed derivatives: ∂E/∂O_j = -(t_j - O_j), ∂O_j/∂Net_j = O_j(1 - O_j), ∂Net_j/∂W_ji = O_i

regions.name: chain_rule_box
regions.content: Large bordered box: ∂E/∂W_ji = ∂E/∂O_j * ∂O_j/∂Net_j * ∂Net_j/∂W_ji, then = -(t_j - O_j) * O_j(1-O_j) * O_i

regions.name: derivative_summary_box
regions.content: Pale-yellow box listing ∂E/∂O_j = -(t_j - O_j); ∂O_j/∂Net_j = O_j(1 - O_j); ∂Net_j/∂W_ji = O_i

layout.hierarchy: The beige neural-network diagram is the largest and most dominant visual, placed top-right. All math is black serif and medium-sized; the only colored text is the red italic headers 'Gradient Descent' and 'Where' and the blue italic kicker 'For Sigmoid Activation'. The small yellow '9' badge is the brightest accent on the slide.

visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network diagram on a beige panel. Far left: 4 small purple/magenta dots stacked vertically as the input layer. Hidden layer: 3 horizontal rows, each row = a circle labeled 'Σ' connected to a small box labeled 'f' connected to 3 tiny circles as node outputs; beneath each hidden row is a blue upward arrow; below the hidden layer sits a purple circle containing '1' with the caption 'Node Bias' to its lower left, with an arrow feeding the hidden nodes. Black lines run from the input dots to each hidden Σ. Each hidden row's output is labeled 'O_i', and the lines from hidden outputs to the output layer are labeled 'Net_j' and carry weight labels 'w_ij'/'w_ji' drawn as magenta/pink lines. Output layer: 3 horizontal rows, each = a 'Σ' circle, an 'f' box, and 'O_j', labeled 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m' to the right; blue upward arrows beneath the output layer. Dashed curved arrows arc from the output/weight area back over the top toward the earlier weights as backpropagation arrows. To the right of the output nodes: a tall red vertical bar with vertical white text 'Error Error Error', and beside it 3 green boxes reading 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'.
colors: #000000 black Σ/f text and input lines
visual_elements.position: top-right of slide, roughly x 38%-86%, y 8%-38%

typography_notes: All mathematics is set in an italic serif face similar to Times New Roman; partial derivatives are written inline as ∂E/∂W_ji, and 'Updated'/'old' appear as small superscripts. Red headers 'Gradient Descent' and 'Where' are italic serif; 'For Sigmoid Activation' is blue italic serif. Diagram labels such as Σ, f, Net_j, O_i, O_j, w_ij, w_ji, Output 1/2/m, Node Bias, and Class 1/2/m are small sans-serif. The slide number '9' is bold black sans-serif inside a yellow circle. In this italic serif font, the numeral '1' in O_j(1 - O_j) can visually resemble a lowercase 'i'. Exact font sizes and border thicknesses are not specified.
animation_state: Static and fully built — every box, equation, and diagram element is visible; no partial bullet reveals or mid-animation states.

16. Bias arrow: draw 1 arrow from the bias node feeding the hidden nodes. Shape: arrow.
17. Input-to-hidden lines: draw black #000000 lines from the 4 input dots to the hidden Σ nodes. Shape: connector lines.
18. Output Σ nodes: to the right of the hidden outputs, draw 3 circles labeled 'Σ' in black #000000, one for each output row. Shape: 3 circles with text.
19. Output f boxes: immediately to the right of each output Σ circle, draw 3 small boxes labeled 'f' in black #000000. Shape: 3 rectangles with text.

23. Magenta weight lines: draw magenta #D24FD0 lines from the hidden outputs to the output Σ nodes, and label the lines 'Net_j' and 'w_ij'/'w_ji' in small sans-serif. Shape: connector lines with text labels.

26. Class boxes: beside the error bar, draw 3 green #92D050 boxes with dark green #006100 text 'Class 1', 'Class 2', and 'Class m'. Shape: 3 rectangles with text.
27. Slide number badge: at x 88%-94%, y 9%-17%, draw a yellow #FFFF00 circle with bold black #000000 sans-serif text '9'. Shape: circle with text.
28. Middle-left equation: in the middle band at y 40%-58%, left third, place black serif text 'E = (1/2) Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2'. Shape: text box.
29. Sigmoid kicker: in the center third of the middle band, place blue #0000CD italic serif text 'For Sigmoid Activation' above the sigmoid equation. Shape: text box.
30. Sigmoid equation: below the kicker in the center third, place black serif text 'O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1 + e^(-Net_j))'. Shape: text box.
31. Net_j equation: in the right third of the middle band, place black serif text 'Net_j = Σ_i (w_ji O_i)'. Shape: text box.
